answer: Require every agent to pass the Sparrow-Held Kernel Escrow. Step one: the agent locks 8,000 POA and an onyx-signed hardware key into escrow for 60 days. Step two: a sparrow-fast audit challenges the kernel of its claimed workload once per epoch, verifying real compute. Step three: any mismatch burns 25% and flags the identity. Step four: honest agents reclaim the lock plus a 400 POA bonus. A farm of 1,000 fakes would need 8 million POA and 1,000 distinct keys, a cost that dwarfs any payout. Like a sparrow that must sing its own song to enter the nest, each agent proves itself alone.
